purpose: Define which cross-domain civic relationships BetterMakati may store or render during W6-4, and the evidence needed to justify them.
principles: Canonical domain modules own labels, URLs, dates, amounts, status and source payloads; the relationship layer stores references and relationship evidence only.
A stored edge must explain a plausible civic question or continuation, not merely increase internal link count.
Reverse navigation is derived from one stored edge; the reverse edge is never duplicated.
A relationship that attributes responsibility, funding, authorship, effect or geography must be supported by explicit canonical data or source-backed evidence.
Curated BetterGov or BetterLGU links are continuation or comparison context, never evidence for a Makati-specific claim.

allowedPatterns.rule: Timeline items may point back to their canonical owner and explicit scoped geography; chronology alone does not create relationships.
Election relationships require exact official/result identity. Do not infer legislative sponsorship, votes, procurement responsibility or project ownership from office alone.
Budget-to-project links require an exact program/project identity, appropriation reference or explicit source statement.
Legislation relationships must come from recorded civic relationships, lifecycle evidence or exact source identity.
A report may relate only to canonical records explicitly declared in its evidence references.
Citywide statistics are not attributed to a barangay or place unless the underlying observation is explicitly reconciled to that geography.
Place geography must use canonical registry geography or source-backed location evidence.
Source relationships use exact canonical identity such as a stored record ID or exact shared source URL.

forbiddenInference: person-name similarity without a canonical ID
same district or same barangay without an explicit geographic relationship
office held as proof of authorship, vote, responsibility or control
citywide statistic as proof about a specific place or barangay
budget category as proof that a specific project was funded
external ecosystem page as proof of a Makati-specific fact
renderingRuleForW64c: Page-family cross-links should answer the strongest next civic question first and should not render generic link dumps when no evidence-backed relationship exists.
